So why am I giving it a bad review?

Primarily because literally EVERYTHING has a WEEKLY LIMIT which bars you from making ANY significant progress on anything in one time. If you have a day off from work, rest assured you will NOT be using that time to grind out that outfit piece you've been wanting. 

To put this into perspective for you:

The bounty system gives you 1000 "fourfold acclaim" for killing a player. You are capped at 1400 a week. You can kill one and a half players through the bounty system before it becomes entirely pointless to do so. And thats not all. If you want one of the only four capes in the game, albiet an ugly brown color, you first need to accumulate 50,000 Fourfold Acclaim to buy it. Yes, you read that right. Fifty Thousand. That means in order to get a brown cape in this game, you need to play the game consistently for a mandatory minimum of EIGHT MONTHS. EIGHT MONTHS IT TAKES TO GET A CAPE.

This is insane. Most of the gameplay is fine if not for the fact you are only allowed to enjoy it at a snails pace, lest you be forced to afk and stare at the wall while you wait for your limits to reset. Its only wednesday and i've hit all the limits. I guess you guys don't want people to play your game?

Beyond that, theres actually a decent amount wrong with the game. The bounty system is broken as hell. It shows you how powerful the player is before you take a bounty on them, which means you will NEVER be invaded by somebody you can just win against. Nobody is going to take a bounty against somebody significantly higher than them. Bounties can be taken no matter what you are doing and will stop you from doing anything in both online and solo mode. I was locked into an emote for a sect mission and i got raided and the guy took a golden opportunity to get a free bounty and killed me while i couldn't fight back. And if you do fight back and kill them, they can literally just jump into some water, teleport away, and then teleport back to you and get all their health back. Me personally, i have avoided the last 10 bounties on my head by building a box in the mud that easily wins against any bounty hunter.

Most of the weapons feel like they are missing something. Only a few of them have heavy attacks. Levels are locked behind gigantic time gates.. Like based on when you started your account. If you are reading this, you WILL have to wait a FULL WEEK to progress from level 55 to level 60. I generally hate pay to win/buying power, but given that the only avenue for this was the battle pass which caps the power buying at a relatively low monetary number, I stomached it. I figured worse case scenario it's a free single player game of surprisingly good quality, given the graphics, storyline, cutscenes, boss design, etc.

However, the story quests are mostly boring, many of the puzzles are contrived, the menu and systems bloat is ridiculous, bugs aren't game breaking but ubiquitous, the localization is terrible, and the gear progression is full of chores that don't actually reward your time investment. Despite all of this, I was still kind of enjoying the game for awhile there. I put about 70 hours in the game and it didn't start feeling to stale until the last 10. Yet, I kept pushing. That is, until my encounter with the bounty system.

I got a bounty bc an npc I disguised myself as saw me. This caused me to be invaded, wasting my 2nd disguise (which aren't cheap) btw. I fought the invader for HALF AN HOUR before they gave up and left. I was frustrated at this point and logged off for a few days. I logged back on after my break only to be immediately invaded again. I nearly beat this invader, after a 10 minute fight, only to be killed by some geese I accidently agro'd during the fight. This caused me to be put in prison, where I have to wait 15 minutes in game without doing anything, or buying my way out, or crafting a bunch of stuff to "get on the warden's good side." The crafts would probably have taken me most of the 15 minutes to complete, but I didn't even get time to test that theory because you have to compete for access to a small number of workbenches that other players will want to use. You can not opt out of the bounty system btw.

So to recap, about 55 minutes of my time was wasted because I got caught wearing a disguise. I don't even know if winning the bounty fight would have ended the invades, because my fight was interrupted by a geese swarm. Having someone fight you for half an hour and leave does not reset your bounty. The prison system presents you with another useless crafting system, and all of that was a prolonged distraction from a game whose online functionality did nothing positive for my enjoyment of the game.

This crushed my last remaining bit of motivation to play this bloated game full of boring, basically mandatory elements (such as the oddity collection). The game is full of potential, but is ultimately a HUGE letdown.
